name: Spiko EU T-Bills Money Market Fund
oneLiner: EUTBL is Spiko's AMF-authorized UCITS short-term VNAV money-market fund backed by Eurozone sovereign T-bills, tokenized for KYC-gated investors.
collateral: Eurozone-government bonds and money-market instruments held by the AMF-regulated Spiko SICAV short-term VNAV money-market sub-fund, managed by Twenty First Capital; the mandate limits weighted average maturity to 60 days or less and residual instrument maturity to six months
pegMechanism: EUR-denominated NAV-accreting share token (ISIN FR001400ODL1) of the Spiko SICAV short-term VNAV money-market sub-fund authorised by the AMF. The mandate permits euro-denominated Eurozone-government bonds and money-market instruments, with weighted average maturity of 60 days or less. Subscriptions, redemptions, and transfers are permissioned through Spiko Finance's shareholder register. The 1 September 2026 prospectus specifies an 11:30 Paris-time order cutoff, execution at the last known NAV subject to exceptional-event recalculation, next-business-day processing for late orders, and €1 minimum subscriptions and redemptions. Spiko has announced Chainlink CCIP interoperability for EUTBL and USTBL. Prospectus: https://cdn.spiko.finance/legal_docs/EN/Prospectus_Spiko_SICAV_EN.pdf

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: SONG-5 Safety Score V9 mechanism review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: EUTBL is an NAV-accreting, regulated Spiko SICAV money-market fund share backed by a short-term Eurozone sovereign bill mandate. The prospectus and KID support the T-bill fund classification, daily dealing, and eligible-instrument maturity limits. They do not establish a current security-level allocation, complete holder seniority and loss-recovery design, or all chain-specific implementation controls.

proofOfReserves.provider: PricewaterhouseCoopers Audit, statutory auditor of Spiko SICAV.
